summary.headline: Chapters 26–53 of Astrological Treatises
summary.text: Chapters 26–53 of a Greek astrological codex cover airs and signs, leaping, falling out, aphetic places and aphetas, radiation, horimaia, zodiac-sign divisions, lunar election, foundations, migrations, shipbuilding, travel, attacks, letters, favors, vessels, disease, surgery, bodily parts ruled by signs and stars, assemblies, figure direction, the seven stars, sign powers, and nativities from culminating and setting. Cross-references cite the Florentine codices and Catalogus Florentinus, with chapter 51 attributed to Rhetorius.
